steps.name: Hungry Townsfolk
steps.text: G-Gracias...

steps.name: Stoic Townsfolk
steps.text: I injured a holy man when I corralled the burdenbeasts and startled one by accident. I will forsake half of my serving as penance.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: No, eat up so that it doesn't happen again.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: There's enough saltfin for everyone. Eat.

steps.name: Stoic Townsfolk
steps.text: But, Señor Silver, overeating is—

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Is better than letting food go to waste. Saltfin flesh won't last in this weather. Finish it before it spoils.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Kindly bring these to our injured brothers, my good chef.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: They need something nutritious to eat, after the beating they've taken these past few days.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Have you reviewed the plan, Señor Alguacil?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: I do not understand how such a notion could have even occurred to you.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: If the bandits surrender the compass and the blueprints for a salt ship, I will pardon most of them and permit them to live as I allow them to.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Many are young and healthy. They will be invaluable labor if this town is to move.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Besides, it will convenient to have sword hands unbound by religious dogma, in the event of any future negotiations.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: They will destroy your town.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Eliminate the Ægir leading them, and the rest are just a disorganized mob. The three whom we have locked up in the basement are each playing their own game.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: I will split them and give them conflicting interests, such that if they do raise their swords, it will only be against their former fellows.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: You once saved these townsfolk, taught them to suppress desire and maintain purity... yet now you would pardon the very bandits who murdered their friends and family, all for worldly benefit?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: Did you imagine the people accepting this?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: How is this anything less than a betrayal?

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: What would you suggest, then?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: I would lead our men into the Flat without delay, eliminate the surviving bandits, and destroy the very means by which they have sinned.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Our injured brothers need rest.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: We have neither the manpower nor the resources for another major campaign.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: I will ensure they are ready.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: I hope you'll forgive my bluntness, Señor Alguacil.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: But the three bandits in the basement will 'escape' at nightfall. If all goes well, they will soon bring news back to their fellows.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: All I need from you is to maintain order when the bandits come to negotiate.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: What made you change your mind?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: It's just a compass. There wasn't much to think about.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Would someone with so little on their mind have such restless hands? Should I be worrying about you making a hole in my ship, joven?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I'm not that strong.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Come now, don't be like that. I hope you realize that being serious all the time only makes you the butt of the joke.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Now grab a change of clothes. You have blood all over you.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...Gracias.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: *Cough* *Cough*...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Sorry, I should have told you to hold your breath. This cabin hasn't been used in decades, and there's dust everywhere.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I'm sorry for touching things without permission.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Don't make me sound like such a petty woman.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You can touch whatever you want here. It's all top-notch alchemical equipment. Unless your hands are more dangerous than cannon fire or a storm, they'll survive.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: This will be your lab from now on.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You have a full-fledged alchemy lab on your ship?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Before I forget...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: These clothes belonged to the previous alchemist. You're about the same size, so try them on.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Oh, uh...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You can change in the storage room to your left.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Do I look weird?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Of course not. It fits you well.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Do you like it? The style is decades-old, but it was tailor-made with the finest fabrics.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: It feels brand-new, though.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: It was meant to be a coming-of-age gift. But he fell into the sea along with the shells of the Iberian Defensa the very day before reaching adulthood.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I searched for his body myself, but never found a trace. I only hope it was the fins that got him. There weren't quite so many Seaborn back then.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You've fought the Iberian Defensa?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: This was before the Profound Silence, when we still sailed the high seas. This very ship, La Conquista, was captured in that era.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I don't suppose you have an interest in history?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: No, I've just heard a few tales about the ocean.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Then fix the compass and see it with your own eyes.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: First you wanted me to fix your compass, now you want me to follow you out to sea?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: It requires an alchemist to operate it.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Let me have a good look at you. Hm... raise your collar a bit, wear the shawl over your shoulder... not bad at all.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Er, I can handle the rest...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Try to avoid any strenuous effort for a few days. Your injuries aren't life-threatening, but given the hygiene on the ship, you can never be too careful.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Yes, yes... Oh! I know what's missing!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: How could I forget?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I haven't given you the compass yet.
Isidro takes the compass from Juana and caresses its surface.
It is light, and cold.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I can't guarantee success, but I'll give it my all.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Your all, you say?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: When I make a promise, I intend to keep it.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Then you shall have all the support I can offer.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Good. First, I'll need an assistant. I'm not asking a lot, just someone clever and hard-working.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Naturally.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Right, and I have one other present for you.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: If what the boss says is true, then we're out of options.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: The townsfolk now control the route from the Flat to the inland, and we're their mortal enemies.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: There's no way back. We have to face the ocean.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Is there really no other way?

steps.name: Anxious Sailor
steps.text: Señor Rus! Señor Javier!

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Slow down and breathe. What's going on?

steps.name: Anxious Sailor
steps.text: Th-They're back!

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Who's back?

steps.name: Anxious Sailor
steps.text: O-Our mates who got caught! They escaped and came back!

steps.name: Anxious Sailor
steps.text: And they brought someone with them!

steps.name: Auctioning Sailor
steps.text: Take a look at this scallywag I found outside!

steps.name: Auctioning Sailor
steps.text: Healthy, works hard, don't eat much. And he's yours for two months of saltfin garum!

steps.name: Joyful Sailor
steps.text: His face is kind of nice...

steps.name: Aloof Sailor
steps.text: He's all skin and bones. A flick of a saltfin's tail would send him packing...
Hey! I take exception to that!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'll have you know I'm ripped under this loose fit!

steps.name: Auctioning Sailor
steps.text: Okay, going for one-and-a-half months of saltfin garum!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: For an absolute adonis like me? I'm worth at least a year of that fin stuff!

spans.text: For an absolute adonis like me? I'm worth at
a year of that fin stuff!

steps.name: Auctioning Sailor
steps.text: Shut up already! Can't you see no one wants you?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Going for one year of saltfin garum!

steps.name: Auctioning Sailor
steps.text: One month!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Two years!

steps.name: Auctioning Sailor
steps.text: Two weeks!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Three years!

steps.name: Auctioning Sailor
steps.text: Pah! Three days!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Deal!

steps.name: Elysium & Auctioning Sailor
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Three days of saltfin garum, under my name. Deal?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Perfect timing. I was just thinking I needed a bodyguard.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Now what to call you... How about Pelirrojito, for that red streak you've got?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You were hiding all this under the Salt Flat?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Shh, do you want the neighbors to hear?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: That wasn't funny.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I'm more surprised you even noticed the joke.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: So did you want me to help you kill this Seaborn?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Then why bring me here?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You came to the Salt Flat seeking a school of swordplay founded by a pirate, did you not?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Then congratulations, you've found it.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: When you need a break from repairing the compass, you can come here and learn from it.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: From a Seaborn?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: A Seaborn that has devoured countless swordsmen. With every movement of its appendages, it recreates their skills.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Perhaps as an attempt to escape, or perhaps a meaningless act of imitation...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...What exactly is going on here?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: It is difficult to explain. After trapping it here, I issued a bounty, inviting any swordsman to try their hand at killing it.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Many have attempted it, but all have become a part of it, along with their blades.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Now I'm even more confused. Why did you trap it here? Why were you looking for someone to kill it?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: And why do you want me to learn swordplay from it?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I was never the original captain of the fleet. It was it... him.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Him?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: His name was Cruz.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: When the waters that inundated this land subsided, the remaining Seaborn began to attack the cities in a frenzy.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We fought hard and slew most of them, but this one was particularly hard to kill. Cruz lured it into a cave, using himself as bait, and both became trapped here.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: The last time I saw him, he named me captain and asked me to bring the others back to the sea.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Why not tell them the truth? I've heard the crew spreading terrible rumors about you and the Seaborn.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Let them. A leader needs to be feared as well as loved.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: So you came up with this entire plan back then?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: No. It was Cruz who gave it to me. He had long expected that he would die before I did, so he told me everything, that I might continue his work after his death.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You should have freed him from... this...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I wanted to. But it's not that easy.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I couldn't do it, not with my own hands... Even though I know it's just a Seaborn. I love him, just as I love the time we spent sailing far and wide.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Promise me. Learn everything you can from it, as much as your little sponge of a brain can absorb.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: That way, at least, I'll get to see his swordplay once more.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Leaf? You've got news from Elysium...?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Play recording.

steps.name: Recording
steps.text: Weedy... I followed the escaping bandits back to their den.

steps.name: Recording
steps.text: Don't worry, no one knows who I am. And I found someone who can protect me.

steps.name: Recording
steps.text: She has a lot of connections here. I'm sure I'll find Thorns soon.

steps.name: Recording
steps.text: Just sit back and wait for the good news.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Bring the crates over here, Pelirrojito!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Yes, boss!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Not bad! You're stronger than you look. Now I want to hear that same energy in your selling.

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: You got it, boss! I've already memorized the entire list of goods, forwards and backwards!

spans.text: You got it, boss! I've already memorized the entire list of goods, forwards

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: (I'm done listening to you the moment I find Thorns!)

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Look, people are coming! Say it so they can hear!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Prosthetic eyeballs! Made from the finest saltfin bones for maximum comfort, in any color you want!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Aged saltfin garum from our special collection! A flavor you won't forget!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Don't miss this chance, señores and señoras!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: (Wow... this guy's a natural. Doesn't sound like a slave at all...)

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Come one, come all, there's something for everyone!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: *Cough* *Cough* I'm getting hoarse, Boss...

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Everybody's staring, but why is no one stopping by?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Yeah... it's weirdly quiet. I'd expect someone to have picked a fight with me by now.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Would you care for one, señor? Could come in handy someday!

steps.name: Flustered Sailor
steps.text: No thanks, Pascuala...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Well, if you're not buying, you're not buying, but what's that look? Gives me the creeps.

steps.name: Flustered Sailor
steps.text: I suggest you put your tail between your legs and behave yourself.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Didn't you say you were well-connected?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I am! Just imagine how much worse it'd be for an outsider like you without me here to smooth things over.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: (These two never used to give me a second glance. Why'd they stop to glare at me today?)

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: You know what, just close up the stall and pack up for today. I'm gonna go ask around.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Is it true what those guys were saying?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Yeah, I sent someone to check.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Do you trust them? That if we hand over the compass and the thief, we all get pardoned and can live in town?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: It's hard to believe.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Then why'd you let that chaval from the city with the red hair onto our fleet?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I don't know what to believe anymore, Rus.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Could be the fickle sea, could be some inscrutable show of good faith. Whatever it is, keeping him around gives us more options.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: If it comes to it... the chica is the easy part: just tie her up and hand her over. But how in the hell would we get the compass from the boss?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I... I'll talk to her. This is about the whole fleet. She'll listen.

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Talk?

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: I used to think maybe you could convince her, but now I'm sure she'd just drag you right back in.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: What do you want me to do then?

steps.name: Rus
steps.text: Who knows? You get to make decisions for the fleet, not me.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: (Those Inquisition finshits... Now they're just playing dirty...)

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: What's with all the sighing, boss?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I heard... *sob*... I heard...

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Come on, don't cry, you can tell me. Maybe I can help.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: You're so nice, Pelirrojito, *sob*...

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: (Who else would I count on here?)

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I'm worried about you.

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Ahem. What does this have to do with me, boss?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: It's one thing to be drifting around on my own, but now I've got you to care of.

spans.text: It's one thing to be drifting around on my own, but now I've got

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: I'm not fired, am I? After all the work I've done for you?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: No... I'm just worried about you getting left all alone with these bandits if something happens to me.

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: (This is practically blackmail!)

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: ...Wow, I didn't think you cared, boss! Don't worry, nothing'll happen to you on my watch!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Oh, Pelirrojito!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Boss!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I... I heard them talking... they want to hand me over to the Inquisition!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: The Inquisition chased me all the way into the Salt Flat! All because of a compass that used to belong to my family!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Your family?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: I may not look it, but my family used to be rich and famous!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: But everything we had was sold off, and the compass somehow ended up with the Inquisition.

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Wow, that's amazing, boss!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: (Yeah right.)

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: So, what do you need me to do?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Ahem. I heard the fleet's alchemist is looking for an assistant, and he's got the boss's trust big time. So, uh, maybe you could try applying?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: You're clever and hardworking and I'm sure you'll get along like peanut butter and jelly! Then you can put in a good word for me.

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Why not just do it yourself?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Well, me and him have a little bit of a history... Maybe more than a bit...

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Anyhow, just work that silver tongue keep an eye out for your chance!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: No problem, boss! I'll step up as soon as he needs me!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Maybe don't be TOO eager... In the end, it comes down to timing.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: We can't make things too easy for him. He's gotta soak in the anxiety, then you can show up right when he needs you most. That way, he'll be helpless without you.

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Why are you making this weird?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Both of our fates are in your hands, Pelirrojito.

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: (You can eat finshit for all I care once I get in that alchemist's good graces!)

steps.name: Crying Sailor
steps.text: Waahh!

steps.name: Crying Sailor
steps.text: H-How could he say that!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Hey, wasn't that Steelface Pele?

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Steelface Pele?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Yeah, says he didn't so much as whimper when he fell from the mast last year.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: So why was he crying like a little kid after leaving that room?

steps.name: Terrified Sailor
steps.text: Are you here to interview for the alchemist assistant's job?

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Er... yeah...

steps.name: Terrified Sailor
steps.text: Turn back if you know what's good for you, chaval.

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Does he have a bad temper?

steps.name: Terrified Sailor
steps.text: No, worse.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Don't worry about it, Pelirrojito. He's a nice guy. He even saved my life.

steps.name: Terrified Sailor
steps.text: Sure, but work always brings out the worst in us.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Now that you mention it...

steps.name: Terrified Sailor
steps.text: He kicked me out in three seconds flat! Said I was breathing too loud!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: (Whisper) Hey, boss, you said you had a history with this guy, right?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: (Whisper) What about it?

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: (Whisper) You're trying to throw me into a fire! I'm not going in!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: (Whisper) We're already here! You're not out of this that easy!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: No, I'm not going! Whatever you're up to, nothing good can come of it!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Just go in! Stop running away!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Get off my shoulders!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: No!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Yow! Stop pulling on my eyebrows! I can't see!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Hey, watch where you're going! You're gonna hit the door!

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Ow ow ow...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Whatever the reason for this racket, you're interrupting my work.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Either I toss you out the window, or you show yourselves out. Choose.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Sorry, sorry, I just wanted to recommend you an assistant.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You mean another of those guys who couldn't tell a beaker from a flask? No thank you, you can keep them.

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: You sure don't mince your words, do you?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: He's new here, Isidro, doesn't know how things work. Don't mind him.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: You...

steps.name: 'Pelirrojito'
steps.text: Yup, me.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Er, excuse me?
Nobody pays any attention to Pascuala. Isidro puts his hand on the shoulder of 'Pelirrojito'.
Who in turn puts his arm on Isidro's shoulder, their two arms linked like cables connecting a bridge.
They pat each other's shoulders so hard, they might as well be punching each other.
Pelirrojito's face turns as red as the streak in his hair, grimacing in pain.
As for Isidro...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Have they been starving you? You pat like a wimp.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Do you even know how much weight I lost looking for you? Hope you're ready to buy me a good meal.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Señores...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: How did you find me?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We can talk about that later. Let's talk about you. How did you get here with all your limbs intact, you lucky boy?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...What's with the tone of disappointment?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Excuse me...
Pascuala finds no room in the conversation for her to butt in.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Never mind.
She turns around and leaves, politely closing the door behind her.
